fine_lines.title: need to vs have to vs must
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة تعبّر عن الضرورة. need to = أحتاج أن، have to = يجب عليّ (بسبب ظروف أو قوانين)، must = يجب (أقوى، وغالبًا رأي المتكلم). بعدها كلها الفعل في أصله، ولا نضع to بعد must.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three show something is necessary. After must, no "to": I must pay.

examples.sentence: I need to clean my apartment.
I have to wash the dishes.

fine_lines.title: messy vs tidy
fine_lines.explanation_en: Messy = not in order. Tidy = in order.

grammar.title: Talking about tasks: need to / have to / must + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: لنتحدث عن المهام الضرورية: I need to + الفعل، I have to + الفعل، I must + الفعل (بدون to). مع he/she نقول: She needs to / She has to.
grammar.explanation_en: For necessary tasks: need to / have to / must + base verb. With he/she: needs to / has to.
examples: I need to clean my apartment.
I have to wash the dishes.

grammar.title: Ordering tasks: first, after that, then
grammar.explanation_ar: نرتّب المهام: First (أولًا)، After that (بعد ذلك)، Then (ثم)، In the afternoon (بعد الظهر).
grammar.explanation_en: Use first, after that, then to order tasks.
examples: First, I need to go to the supermarket.
After that, I need to water the plants.
Then I need to go to the bank.

grammar.title: want to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم want to + الفعل لنقول ما نريد: I want to buy fruit.
grammar.explanation_en: Use want to + base verb for wishes.
examples: I want to buy fruit, rice, and chicken.
I want to make dinner for my sister.

questions.question: I must ___ some bills.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد must الفعل في أصله بدون to.
questions.explanation_en: After "must" use the base verb, no "to".

questions.question: My room is very ___. There are clothes on the floor.
A doctor for teeth is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A dentist is a doctor for teeth.

questions.question: I have a dentist ___ at 3 p.m.
questions.explanation_en: An appointment is a fixed meeting time.

questions.question: I have to take out the ___.
questions.explanation_ar: take out the trash = يُخرج القمامة.

questions.question: Someone has a difficult appointment. You say:
I need to ___ my dry cleaning. My dress is ready.
She ___ to go to the bank.
I need to water the ___ and walk my dog.
